title: Epan: Add dissector for LS ELECTRIC XGT protocol
description:
This Merge Request adds a new dissector for the XGT FEnet protocol, which is a proprietary communication protocol developed by LS ELECTRIC (formerly LS Industrial Systems) for their XGT series PLCs.

Key Features:
Supports both TCP (Port 2004) and UDP (Port 2005) transports as per the official specifications.
Implements disassembly for various request and response types, including:
Individual/Continuous Read and Write operations.
PLC Information and Status requests.
Handles FEnet header, PLC info area, and application data structures.
Project Context: This contribution is a result of the SLiMe team project from the 14th Best of the Best (BoB) program. Our team focused on industrial protocol analysis and security.

Testing:
Verified with sample traffic from LS ELECTRIC XGK-CPUS series.
Passed all static analysis checks using checkAPIs.pl, checkfiltername.pl, and detect_bad_proto_tree_add.py.
Attached Sample PCAP: [xgt_fenet.pcap](/uploads/280161545d78fb3f1a48de1f85462051/xgt_fenet.pcap)

Please find the attached capture file for verification purposes.

Unlike with UDP, with TCP you cannot assume that the PDU's are aligned with the segments transported by TCP. Therefore you'll need to find the PDU boundaries first and then hand the TVB to the dissection function, or ask the TCP dissector for more data first. This is all handled through a support function in the TCP dissector `tcp_dissect_pdus()`. see doc/README.dissector section 2.7 for more details how to so this.
